question: Power Grid Corporation of India Limited: how much of the balance sheet is CWIP and capitalised interest, and when does it start depreciating?
answer: CWIP and capitalised interest as separate balance-sheet line items are not in the held fact store (no CWIP atom, no capitalised-interest atom). From the latest concall/deck references, CWIP was about ₹29,603 crore as of 31-Dec-2024 and ₹50,419 crore as of 30-Jun-2026 (within works in hand). Depreciation under the regulated tariff (RTM) regime starts on commissioning at 5.28% per year for the initial 12 years, then falls to about 1.1-1.3% per year for the remaining ~23 years.
